Definition: from a compound of G1418 and G5345; defamation:--evil report.
BiblicalUsage: Evil report, defamation, as Paul commends himself as a minister of God through honour and dishonour, through evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a good report and an evil report are both part of the ministry, because the world will call the true deceivers and the deceivers true.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
